decision: José, 2026-11-23: show only the three datasets being rebuilt now, so the site carries the updated 'what we fixed' pages. Every other dataset is hidden, not deleted, and is listed as plain text in a closed section called 'Coming later' on the catalog.
how_to_show_another: Add its slug to 'shown' and remove it from 'later' or 'later_group', rerun contributor_tools/dataset_status.py, contributor_tools/build_audit_evidence_page.py and contributor_tools/build_fixes_page.py, and restore its catalog row. Hidden dataset pages stay on disk under docs/datasets/<slug>/ and are left out of the build.
